notes: Chart is printed as [4.44b] Italian Organization at Arrival Chart on the scan.
Arrives is printed OpStage/Game-Turn (the intro: '#/-' is the Operations Stage, '-/#' the Game-Turn); e.g. 1/18 = OpStage 1 of Game-Turn 18.
Arrives 'D' = deployed at start on the map; recorded as arrives null with a note.
Parent follows the sheet's indentation: an indented unit is assigned to the nearest less-indented unit above it; an unindented unit has no parent.
TOE 'N' = the unit has the full TOE for its ID code (Unit Characteristics Chart); recorded as an empty toe with a note. 'U@x' = understrength at x TOE points; 'O@x' = overstrength at x.
HQ^E on the sheet marks an HQ with engineering capability; the superscript is kept in the name as ^E.

Read twice (archive.org scan jp2 146-160; community 300 dpi Axis Charts.pdf pp. 4-18) and diffed: 1956 cells compared; after aligning conventions the reads differ only where a heading row (an artillery grouping with no counter) was taken as a parent, and on the 46th Artillery Regt of the Trento sheet, printed slightly left of its siblings: read as assigned to the division HQ like the other divisional units.
Arrives: the sheets print Operations Stage / Game-Turn; D (deployed) is "deployed". toe_mark N means the maximum TOE for the unit's ID code.

Counters listed on a division sheet as attached but printed again on their home sheet (Unassigned Armored, Unassigned Blackshirt, the Libyan Tank Command) have one id, on the home sheet; the division sheet lists them under attached.
The chart sets head this chart 4.44b (Italian Organization at Arrival).
The 61st Sirte, 62nd Marmarica and 63rd Cirene sheets were left out of the printed chart set; they come from SPI's errata.
